description: Use this when the user asks what people searched when their Apple Ads showed, which searches Search Match matched, or which searches to add as keywords or negatives. Apple's search terms report for one app's Apple Ads campaigns over the last 90 days (Apple's limit), read with each full sync: each search people typed, the campaign and ad group, whether Search Match found it (source AUTO) or one of the keywords did (source TARGETED, with the keyword and its match type), impressions, taps, installs and spend. to_add lists Search Match searches that brought installs and aren't a keyword yet (judged against every keyword the campaigns have, read from Apple, so one just added counts); no_installs lists searches with 5 taps or more and no install; waiting lists active keywords added in the last 14 days that have had no impression yet, with the day each was added; never_shown lists active keywords added longer ago with no impression in the history kept. Keywords are read once a day. Apple leaves out searches with fewer than 10 impressions. Read-only: it adds or blocks no keyword.
name: apple_ads_search_terms
title: Apple Ads search terms
